title: ADF reliability: retries, idempotency and monitoring
summary: Design the pipeline so rerunning after a transient failure does not corrupt results.

blocks.text: Design the pipeline so rerunning after a transient failure does not corrupt results.

items: Set retries for transient operations, not deterministic data-quality failures.
Use idempotent writes or run-scoped staging plus atomic promotion when possible.
Define alerts around failed runs, duration anomalies and freshness SLA breaches.
